title: Underwriting Service Levels, Condition Deadlines and Document Age Limits for the Mortgage Loan File
content:
Larkspur's underwriting schedule for the Mortgage Loan File sets, per program, how fast decisions and condition reviews are turned, when condition documents are due, how long a file may stay suspended, and how old credit documents and credit reports may be.

## Turn times and deadlines

| Program | Initial underwriting decision (business days after submission) | Review of documents received against a condition (business days) | Borrower documents due (calendar days after a condition is issued) | Suspense period before closure for incompleteness (calendar days) | Response period in the notice of incompleteness (calendar days) | Resubmissions from suspense before senior underwriter review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 3 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 2 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 1 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 2 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 4 | 2 | 7 | 45 | 30 | 1 |

## Age limits

| Program | Maximum age of income and asset documents on the expected note date (calendar days) | Maximum age of a credit report for use on a note, also the reuse window for a reissued report (calendar days) | Verbal verification of employment completed within (business days before the note date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 120 | 120 | 10 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 90 | 90 | 5 |

The credit report age limit is also the credit report validity window: the number of calendar days for which a pulled tri-merge report may be used on a note and reissued to another file.

## Program contrasts

- The Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program runs on tighter limits throughout: documents due 7 calendar days after a condition is issued instead of 10, a 90-day age limit instead of 120, and senior underwriter review after 1 resubmission instead of 2, while allowing a longer suspense period of 45 days.
- The Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed program carries a 3-business-day initial decision service level; the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program 4; every other program 2.
